extracted.intended_audience: USPTO patent examiners (for drafting Office actions) and patent practitioners reading those form paragraphs
extracted.subtask_description: Official MPEP form paragraphs and examiner guidance for preparing Office actions and requirements for information in patent prosecution (including accelerated-examination variants and procedural instructions).

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.84.01.AE Paper Is Unsigned – Application Under Accelerated Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: The proposed reply filed on [1] has not been entered because it is unsigned. Since the above-mentioned reply appears to be bona fide, applicant is given a TIME PERIOD of TWO (2) MONTHS within which to supply the omission or correction in order to avoid abandonment. This application has been granted special status under the accelerated examination program. Extensions of this time period may be granted under 37 CFR 1.136(a). However, filing a petition for extension of time will result in the application being taken out of the accelerated examination program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Objective of accelerated examination is completion within 12 months; replies must be filed electronically via EFS-Web for expeditious processing; if not filed electronically final disposition may occur later than 12 months. Examiner should first try to contact applicant by telephone to request signed reply or ratification; if unsuccessful use this form paragraph in a letter requiring a properly signed reply or ratification if reply is to a non-final Office action. This form paragraph may only be used in applications filed on or after Aug 25, 2006 that have special status under accelerated exam or other grounds under 37 CFR 1.102(c)(2) or (d). Do not use for applications with special status under 1.102(c)(1) based on health/age or PPH.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.84.01 Paper Is Unsigned
rubrics_metrics.description: Form paragraph addressing when a proposed reply is unsigned; applicant given time period to supply omission or correction to avoid abandonment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Same practice as above but not limited to accelerated examination; examiner notes and time-period rules apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.85 Amendment Under 37 CFR 1.312 Entered
rubrics_metrics.description: The amendment filed on [1] under 37 CFR 1.312 has been entered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use for amendments under 1.312 that do not affect the scope of the claims (may be signed by primary examiner) and for amendments entered under 1.312 which do affect the scope of the claims (requires signature of supervisory patent examiner). See MPEP § 714.16.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.86 Amendment Under 37 CFR 1.312 Entered in Part
rubrics_metrics.description: The proposed reply filed on [1] has not been entered because it is unsigned. The amendment filed on [ ] entered-in-part. [2]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When an amendment under 1.312 contains plural changes, some acceptable and some not, the acceptable changes should be entered. Indicate which changes have and have not been entered with appropriate explanation in bracket 2.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.87 Amendment Under 37 CFR 1.312 Not Entered
rubrics_metrics.description: Form paragraph to notify applicant that an amendment under 37 CFR 1.312 has not been entered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify the reasons for non-entry in the appropriate bracket (e.g., 'The amendment changes the scope of the claims.').

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.95 Bona Fide, Non-Responsive Amendments
rubrics_metrics.description: The reply filed on [1] is not fully responsive to the prior Office action because of the following omission(s) or matter(s): [2]. See 37 CFR 1.111. Since the above-mentioned reply appears to be bona fide, applicant is given a TIME PERIOD of TWO (2) MONTHS from the mailing date of this notice within which to supply the omission or correction in order to avoid abandonment. EXTENSIONS OF THIS TIME PERIOD MAY BE GRANTED UNDER 37 CFR 1.136(a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when reply is bona fide but non-responsive due to omissions; related form paragraph for amendment under 1.132 not entered. Examiner note: specify reasons for non-entry in bracket 2.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.90 Abandonment, Failure to Reply
rubrics_metrics.description: This application is abandoned in view of applicant’s failure to submit a proper reply to the Office action mailed on [1] within the required period for reply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not mail a letter of abandonment until after the period for requesting an extension under 37 CFR 1.136(a) has expired. Pro se cases have a specific form paragraph (7.98.02).

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.91 Reply Is Not Fully Responsive, Extension of Time Suggested
rubrics_metrics.description: The reply filed on [1] is not fully responsive to the prior Office action because: [2]. Since the period for reply set forth in the prior Office action has expired, this application will become abandoned unless applicant corrects the deficiency and obtains an extension of time under 37 CFR 1.136(a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Date on which petition under 37 CFR 1.136(a) and fee filed is the date for determining the period of extension and fee amount. Cannot reply outside the six (6) month statutory period or obtain extension for more than five (5) months beyond the date for reply set in an Office action. Examiner Note: set forth why examiner considers failure to take 'complete and proper action' within statutory period. If reply appears bona fide with inadvertent omission, use 7.95 instead. No authority to grant extension where omission was deliberate or application subject to final Office action.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.95.AE Bona Fide, Non-Responsive Amendments – Application Under Accelerated Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: The reply filed on [1] is not fully responsive to the prior Office action because of the following omission(s) or matter(s): [2]. See 37 CFR 1.111. Since the above-mentioned reply appears to be bona fide, applicant is given a TIME PERIOD of TWO (2) MONTHS from the mailing date of this notice within which to supply the omission or correction in order to avoid abandonment. This application has been granted special status under the accelerated examination program. Extensions of this time period may be granted under 37 CFR 1.136(a). However, filing a petition for extension of time will result in the application being taken out of the accelerated examination program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Objective of accelerated examination is completion within 12 months; replies must be filed electronically via EFS-Web. This form paragraph does not apply where omission was deliberate or subject to a final Office action. May be used only in applications filed on or after Aug 25, 2006 granted special status under AE or other grounds under 1.102(c)(2) or (d); not for 1.102(c)(1) health/age/PPH cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.95.01 Lack of Arguments in Response
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant should submit an argument under the heading 'Remarks' pointing out disagreements with the examiner’s contentions. Applicant must also discuss the references applied against the claims, explaining how the claims avoid the references or distinguish from them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This form paragraph must be preceded by form paragraph 7.95. Intended primarily for use in pro se applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.96 Citation of Relevant Prior Art
rubrics_metrics.description: The prior art made of record and not relied upon is considered pertinent to applicant’s disclosure. [1]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When such prior art is cited, its relevance should be explained in bracket 1 in accordance with MPEP § 707.05.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.97 Claims Allowed
rubrics_metrics.description: Claim [1] allowed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to indicate allowance of specific claim(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.98 Reply Is Late, Extension of Time Suggested
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant’s reply was received in the Office on [1], which is after the expiration of the period for reply set in the last Office action mailed on [2]. This application will become abandoned unless applicant obtains an extension of time to reply to the last Office action under 37 CFR 1.136(a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not use in reexamination proceedings or litigation-related reissue applications as 37 CFR 1.136(a) does not apply there.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.98.01 Reply Is Late, Extension of Time Suggested, Pro Se
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant’s reply to the Office Action of [1] was received in the Patent and Trademark Office on [2], which is after the expiration of the period for reply set in the above noted Office action. The application will become abandoned unless applicant obtains an extension of the period for reply set in the above noted Office action. An extension may be obtained by filing a petition under 37 CFR 1.136(a) accompanied by the appropriate fee as set forth in 37 CFR 1.17(a). The date on which the reply, petition, and fee have been filed is the date of the reply and also the date for purposes of determining the period of extension and the corresponding amount of the fee. The expiration of the time period is determined by the amount of the fee paid. Applicant is advised that in no case can any extension carry the date for reply to an Office action beyond the maximum period of SIX MONTHS set by statute. Additionally, extensions may not be granted under 37 CFR 1.136(a) for more than FIVE MONTHS beyond the time period set in an Office action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enclose a photocopy of current fee schedule with action so applicant can determine required fee.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.98.02 Reply Is Late, Petition To Revive Suggested, Pro Se
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant’s reply to the Office Action of [1] was received in the Patent and Trademark Office on [2], which is after the expiration of the period for reply set in the last Office Action. Since no time remains for applicant to obtain an extension of the period for reply by filing a petition under 37 CFR 1.136(a), this application is abandoned. Applicant is advised that the abandonment may only be overcome by filing a petition to revive under 37 CFR 1.137 if the failure to reply was unintentional.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements for a petition to revive under 37 CFR 1.137: (1) the required reply (which has been filed); (2) a statement that the entire delay was unintentional; (3) any terminal disclaimer required under 1.137(d); and (4) the $[3] petition fee per 37 CFR 1.17(m). No consideration of the petition's substance until fee received. Director may require additional info. Required items/fees must be submitted under a cover letter entitled 'Petition to Revive.' Provide mailing and fax addresses and telephone contacts for Office of Petitions. See MPEP § 711.03(c).

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.100 Name And Number of Examiner To Be Contacted
rubrics_metrics.description: Any inquiry concerning this communication should be directed to [1] at telephone number [2].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this form paragraph (or 7.101/7.102) at conclusion of all actions. In bracket 1 insert name of examiner designated to be contacted first (could be non-signatory or signatory); bracket 2 insert area code and phone number.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.101 Telephone Inquiry Contacts - Non 5/4/9 Schedule
rubrics_metrics.description: Communications from the examiner should be directed to [1] whose telephone number is [2]. The examiner can normally be reached on [3] from [4] to [5]. If attempts to reach examiner unsuccessful, supervisor [6] can be reached on [7]. Fax number provided. Information about PAIR system availability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide name, phone, work days, duty hours, SPE name and SPE phone in brackets. Note about Private/Public PAIR and EBC contact number. Use when examiner not on 5/4/9 schedule.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.102 Telephone Inquiry Contacts - 5/4/9 Schedule
rubrics_metrics.description: Communications from the examiner should be directed to [1] whose telephone number is [2]. The examiner can normally be reached on [3] from [4] to [5]. The examiner can also be reached on alternate [6]. If attempts unsuccessful, the supervisor [7] can be reached on [8]. Fax number and PAIR information provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide bracket values including compressed day off in bracket 6 and SPE contact. Use for examiners on 5/4/9 schedule.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.103 Statute Cited in Prior Office Action
rubrics_metrics.description: The text of those sections of Title 35, U.S. Code not included in this action can be found in a prior Office action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to refer applicants to statutory text in previous communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.104.aia Requirement for Information, Public Use or Sale or Other Public Availability
rubrics_metrics.description: An issue of public use, on sale activity, or other public availability has been raised. In order for the examiner to properly consider patentability under 35 U.S.C. 102(a)(1), additional information regarding this issue is required as follows: [1]. Applicant is reminded that failure to fully reply will result in abandonment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by form paragraph 7.105 and followed by form paragraphs 7.122–7.126 as appropriate. Use only in applications filed on or after March 16, 2013 where claims are examined under AIA 35 U.S.C. 102/103 as amended. Information sought should be restricted to that reasonably necessary for examiner to render decision (see MPEP § 2133.03). Set two-month time period unless part of an SSP. If sufficient evidence exists to establish prima facie public use/sale, use form paragraph 7.16.aia to make a rejection under 102(a)(1).

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.104.fti Requirement for Information, Public Use or Sale (pre-AIA)
rubrics_metrics.description: An issue of public use or on sale activity has been raised. In order for the examiner to properly consider patentability under pre-AIA 35 U.S.C. 102(b), additional information regarding this issue is required as follows: [1]. Applicant is reminded that failure to fully reply will result in abandonment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126. Information sought should be limited to reasonably necessary. Two-month reply period ordinarily unless SSP. If sufficient evidence exists to establish prima facie case of public use/on-sale, use form paragraph 7.16.fti to make a rejection under pre-AIA 102(b).

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.104.02 Requirement for Information, Rescission of Statement Under 37 CFR 1.55 or 1.78
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant submitted a rescission of a prior-filed 1.55/1.78 statement indicating claims have effective filing date on or after March 16, 2013. Examiner requires additional information to consider patentability under appropriate law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126. In bracket 1 specify each factual assertion as separate numbered sentence and append '(agree/disagree)' to facilitate applicant's reply. Information sought should be restricted to that reasonably necessary for examination. Two-month reply period unless part of SSP.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.105 Requirement for Information, Heading
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant and the assignee are required under 37 CFR 1.105 to provide the following information that the examiner has determined is reasonably necessary to the examination of this application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This heading should appear at beginning of any requirement under 37 CFR 1.105 and be followed by explanation of why required information is necessary. Form paragraphs 7.104.aia, 7.104.fti, 7.104.02 or 7.106–7.121 may be used as appropriate. Requirement should conclude with form paragraphs 7.122–7.126 as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.105.01 Stipulations of Facts Known to Applicant
rubrics_metrics.description: In response to this requirement, please agree or disagree to the stipulation of each of the following assertions of facts: [1].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126. Suggested to append '(agree/disagree)' at end of each assertion to facilitate marking up a copy.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.105.02 Interrogatories of Facts Known to Applicant
rubrics_metrics.description: In response to this requirement, please provide answers to each of the following interrogatories eliciting factual information: [1].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126. In bracket 1 specify each interrogatory question as separate numbered sentence; scope must be clearly set forth and expected reply characterized as factual information.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.106 Domain of Search
rubrics_metrics.description: The information is required to extend the domain of search for prior art. Limited amounts of art related to the claimed subject matter are available within the Office, and are generally found in class [1] and subclasses [2], which describe [3]. A broader range of art to search is necessary to establish the level of knowledge of those of ordinary skill in the claimed subject matter art of [4].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126. In bracket 4 insert description of art claimed but not found in classification system.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.107 Level of Skill and Knowledge in the Art
rubrics_metrics.description: The information is required to document the level of skill and knowledge in the art of [1].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.108 Background Description
rubrics_metrics.description: The information is required to complete the background description in the disclosure by documenting [1].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126 as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.109 Products and Services Embodying Invention
rubrics_metrics.description: The information is required to identify products and services embodying the disclosed subject matter of [1] and identify the properties of similar products and services found in the prior art.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.110 Art Suggested as Relevant
rubrics_metrics.description: The information is required to enter in the record the art suggested by the applicant as relevant to this examination in [1].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126. In bracket 1 describe where in the application file applicant suggests the art is relevant (specification page, paper date and page, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.111 List of Keywords
rubrics_metrics.description: In response to this requirement, please provide a list of keywords that are particularly helpful in locating publications related to the disclosed art of [1].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.112 Citations for Electronically Searchable Databases or Other Indexed Collections
rubrics_metrics.description: In response to this requirement, please provide a list of citations to electronically searchable databases or other indexed collections containing publications that document the knowledge within the disclosed art of [1].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.113 Copy of Art Referred to in the Disclosure, But Not Submitted
rubrics_metrics.description: In response to this requirement, please provide a copy of each of the following items of art referred to in the [1].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126. In bracket 1 describe where in the file applicant refers to art not previously submitted (specification page or paper date and page).

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.114 Copies of Publications Authored by Inventor(s)
rubrics_metrics.description: In response to this requirement, please provide copies of each publication which any of the applicants authored or co-authored and which describe the disclosed subject matter of [1].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.115 Art Relied Upon for Description of Prior Art
rubrics_metrics.description: In response to this requirement, please provide the title, citation and copy of each publication that is a source used for the description of the prior art in the disclosure. For each publication, provide a concise explanation of that publication’s contribution to the description of the prior art.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126. Requirement limited to documents actually relied on, not those merely believed relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.116 Art Relied Upon for Development of Invention
rubrics_metrics.description: In response to this requirement, please provide the title, citation and copy of each publication that any of the applicants relied upon to develop the disclosed subject matter, particularly as to developing [1]. Provide a concise explanation of the reliance placed on that publication in the development of the disclosed subject matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126. Limited to documents actually relied on. In bracket 1 insert description of most important inventive elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.117 Art Relied Upon for Drafting Claimed Subject Matter
rubrics_metrics.description: In response to this requirement, please provide the title, citation and copy of each publication that was relied upon to draft the claimed subject matter. For each publication, provide a concise explanation of the reliance placed on that publication in distinguishing the claimed subject matter from the prior art.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126. Limited to documents actually relied on.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.118 Results of Applicant’s Prior Art Search
rubrics_metrics.description: In response to this requirement, state whether any search of prior art was performed. If a search was performed, state the citation for each prior art collection searched. If any art retrieved from the search was considered material to demonstrating the knowledge of a person having ordinary skill in the art to the disclosed [1], provide the citation for each piece and a copy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126. In bracket 1 describe the subject matter for which art is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.119 Names of Products or Services Incorporating Claimed Invention
rubrics_metrics.description: In response to this requirement, please provide the names of any products or services that have incorporated the claimed subject matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.120 Names of Products or Services Incorporating Disclosed Prior Art
rubrics_metrics.description: In response to this requirement, please provide the names of any products or services that have incorporated the disclosed prior art [1].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126. In bracket 1 specify attributes of the prior art that most closely approximate the claimed subject matter to narrow focus of reply.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.121 Details of Improvement Over the Prior Art
rubrics_metrics.description: In response to this requirement, please state the specific improvements of the subject matter in claims [1] over the disclosed prior art and indicate the specific elements in the claimed subject matter that provide those improvements. For claims expressed as means or steps plus function, provide specific page and line numbers within the disclosure which describe the claimed structure and acts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.122 Submission of Only Pertinent Pages Where Document is Large
rubrics_metrics.description: Where a document is a bound text or single article over 50 pages, the requirement may be met by providing copies of those pages that provide the particular subject matter indicated in the requirement, or where not indicated, the subject matter found in applicant’s disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.122–7.126 as appropriate. Use where scope of requirement specifically includes copies of publications.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.123 Waiver of Fee and Statement Requirements for Certain Information Disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: The fee and certification requirements of 37 CFR 1.97 are waived for those documents submitted in reply to this requirement. This waiver extends only to those documents within the scope of the requirement under 37 CFR 1.105 that are included in the applicant’s first complete communication responding to this requirement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.124 and either 7.125 or 7.126 as appropriate. Use where scope specifically includes citations to and/or copies of publications. Supplemental replies or information beyond scope are subject to fee/certification under 37 CFR 1.97.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.124 Contents of Good Faith Reply
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant is reminded that the reply to this requirement must be made with candor and good faith under 37 CFR 1.56. Where the applicant does not have or cannot readily obtain an item of required information, a statement that the item is unknown or cannot be readily obtained may be accepted as a complete reply to the requirement for that item.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and followed by 7.125 or 7.126. Should appear in conclusion of any requirement for information.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.125 Conclusion of Requirement That Accompanies Office Action
rubrics_metrics.description: This requirement is an attachment of the enclosed Office action. A complete reply to the enclosed Office action must include a complete reply to this requirement. The time period for reply to this requirement coincides with the time period for reply to the enclosed Office action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and appear at conclusion of any requirement for information that accompanies an Office action. If requirement mailed without other Office action, use 7.126. Form paragraph 7.127 should appear at end of any Office action that includes an attached requirement for information.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.126 Conclusion Of Requirement Mailed Without Any Other Office Action
rubrics_metrics.description: This requirement is subject to provisions of 37 CFR 1.134, 1.135 and 1.136 and has a shortened statutory period of [1] months. EXTENSIONS OF THIS TIME PERIOD MAY BE GRANTED UNDER 37 CFR 1.136(a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be preceded by 7.105 and used when requirement mailed without any other Office action. Period for reply ordinarily set for 2 months. Follow with appropriate form paragraphs 7.122–7.126.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.126.AE Conclusion of Requirement Mailed Without Any Other Office Action – Application Under Accelerated Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: This requirement has a shortened statutory period of TWO (2) MONTHS. This application has been granted special status under the accelerated examination program. Extensions of time may be granted under 37 CFR 1.136(a). However, filing a petition for extension will result in the application being taken out of the accelerated examination program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Objective of accelerated examination is to complete examination within 12 months. Any reply must be filed electronically via EFS-Web. If reply is not filed electronically final disposition may occur later than 12 months. May only be used in applications filed on or after Aug 25, 2006 granted special AE status or other provisions under 1.102(c)(2) or (d). Not for 1.102(c)(1) health/age/PPH cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.127 Conclusion of Office Action That Includes Requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: This Office action has an attached requirement for information under 37 CFR 1.105. A complete reply to this Office action must include a complete reply to the attached requirement for information. The time period for reply to the attached requirement coincides with the time period for reply to this Office action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Should appear at the end of any Office action that includes an attached requirement for information.

rubrics_metrics.name: ¶ 7.147 Supplemental Reply Not Approved for Entry
rubrics_metrics.description: The supplemental reply filed on [1] was not entered because supplemental replies are not entered as a matter of right except as provided in 37 CFR 1.111(a)(2)(ii). [2].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to notify applicant that supplemental reply filed on or after Oct 21, 2004 is not approved for entry. Do not use if supplemental reply has been entered (use PTOL-326 or PTOL-37). Do not use if supplemental reply filed within period during which action is suspended by the Office under 37 CFR 1.103(a) or (c) (those must be entered). If supplemental reply filed during suspended period is not in compliance with 1.121, mail notice of non-compliant amendment (PTOL-324).
